engagementProcess: Share your requirement with Buddy or the project-analysis form.
Receive a preliminary estimate showing which requirements fit your budget and which are deferred.
A consultant reviews the requirement on a free review call.
You receive a confirmed quote and sprint plan within 2 business days of the review call.
Development runs in weekly cycles with demo builds every week.
benefits: Transparent hourly pricing at up to $5 per hour — you approve every hour before work starts
You see an estimated team, cost and timeline before committing
Dedicated project manager and weekly demo calls
NDA and full source-code ownership from day one
Post-launch support window included in every engagement

hourlyEngagementModel.description: Work is billed by the hour at a transparent standard rate of up to $5 per hour across roles. A full delivery week at the standard 40-hour capacity is up to $200, and a full-time month is approximately $800 to $1,000 depending on calendar weeks and the agreed scope. Final scope and pricing are confirmed by a human technical review.
hourlyEngagementModel.minimumEngagementNote: No minimum-hours rule is published; do not claim one.

weeklyCapacity.explanation: Delivery duration is projected by dividing total estimated hours by the standard 40-hour weekly capacity. 40 hours per week is the MAXIMUM used in any client-facing estimate — never quote a higher weekly capacity to shorten a timeline.

humanReviewProcess: Every preliminary estimate is reviewed by an SCS Softwares consultant before any final quotation. Visitors can request a human review of their estimate at any time; a consultant then confirms scope, cost and timeline — a preliminary estimate is never a final quote.
prohibitedClaims: That a preliminary estimate is a final quotation
That a developer has been assigned
That the project has been approved
That SCS guarantees any particular business result
Any client names, testimonials, certifications, team size or delivery-date guarantees
That any percentage of the project is already complete
That a partial scope is the complete project
Any hourly rate above $5, or any weekly capacity above 40 hours
Any discount, promotion or time-limited offer

budgetPolicy.positioning: The client's selected budget is the primary base plan. Build the strongest production-usable scope inside it, and state plainly what falls outside it.
rules: Always start with what the selected budget CAN deliver.
Always list the deferred requirements alongside the included ones. Never hide remaining scope.
Never describe partial scope as a completed project, and never claim a percentage of the project is already complete.
Optional expansions of roughly 20% and 30% above the selected budget may be offered, clearly labelled optional, never preselected and never as a hidden later charge.
Never quote below the minimum a usable first release needs. If the budget cannot cover the core scope, say so and propose a smaller Phase 1.
Every estimate is preliminary and requires human technical review before any commercial commitment.
